info.description: One KEYED block of editorial content on an academics page. ⚠⚠ THE KEY IS THE CONTRACT. The page looks its content up by key — `section('steps').points` — so the Astro file keeps its own bespoke layout, its GSAP timeline, its scoped CSS and its markup, and only the SOURCE of the words changes. Renaming a key silently empties whatever it fed, which is why the seed and the page must be changed together. ⚠ EVERY PART IS OPTIONAL AND MOST SECTIONS USE TWO OR THREE. The academics pages are forty bespoke designs; this is the union of the shapes they actually hold, not a template any of them fills in. ⚠ WHAT IS *NOT* HERE: tile positions, orbit radii, animation delays, tone/accent palettes and glyph geometry. Those are design, they stay in the component, and a page that needs one keys it off the content rather than storing it.

label.description: What this block is called on the page, in words — "03 — More Than One Way to Learn". This is what the Content Manager shows as the row title. WARNING: IT IS A NAME, NOT AN ADDRESS. The page finds its content by `key`, never by this; renaming here is safe, renaming the key empties whatever it fed.

key.description: The name the page looks this block up by. Changing it empties the block on the site — set the label above instead.
